title: NC-FILED-ORIGIN-generic-2026-11-15-t672: Cache D1 read queries at the edge with Workers KV (60s TTL) to cut D1 read bill
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the backlog item FILED-ORIGIN-generic-2026-11-15-t672 was parked needs-code by the in-tick doer
**Done check:** D1 rows_read in the Cloudflare billing dashboard drops >50% week-over-week with no change in p95 latency
**Status:** open

Cache D1 read queries at the edge with Workers KV (60s TTL) to cut D1 read bill

Triage: Requires deploying a canary Worker with KV caching logic and code changes to GET endpoints; in-Worker doer can only edit the backlog DB, not code or deploy. | first step: Open a code-change ticket specifying canary Worker with KV read-through cache (60s TTL), cf-cache-status/KV assertions, and billing rows_read verifica

Bridged from the backlog by scripts/needs_code_bridge.py (NEEDS-CODE-BRIDGE-1). The change is code, data or a test that a loop consumes; a document alone does not close it.
